title: Dereth Town Tour - Candeth Keep scratch

shots.standingOrder: Fly north up the moat ravine west of Candeth Keep above the palm tops, the sheer cliff and the fortress wall towering on the right.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING (drone.canyon-run). 140 m north up the moat ravine that rings the Candeth mesa, at z 36 (20-24 m over the floor, above the palm tops) with the 34 m sedimentary cliff and the fortress wall and corner towers (to z 67.6) towering on the right, lit by the afternoon sun from the west; palms slide below, the outer rim on the left.
